sources.title: MIVUBI Command Execution and Selector Context Policy v1

facts.subject: command execution envelope
facts.statement: Every critical command path should be reasoned about with an explicit execution envelope: executor, dimension, position, rotation, anchor, arena scope, and session/arena generation. Missing fields are unknown, not implicitly safe.

facts.subject: critical target selectors
facts.statement: Critical gameplay commands in multi-arena maps must not use bare @a, @e, or origin-sensitive @p without explicit project-owned arena/generation scope.

facts.subject: selector membership proof
facts.statement: A tag alone is insufficient proof of current arena membership when stale tags are possible. Critical selectors must correlate current arena identity/generation or use a registry-driven target list.

facts.subject: command block execution
facts.statement: For command-block logic, analyzer should derive and record command-block position and dimension as the default execution origin; code must not assume player-relative @p/radius semantics unless execute explicitly changes context.

facts.subject: nested execute
facts.statement: Analyzer should compute context evolution through nested execute clauses instead of evaluating only the final selector string. as/at/in/positioned/rotated/anchored each modifies a different context field.

facts.subject: selector no-match
facts.statement: For critical commands, selector no-match must be surfaced as a diagnostic with expected scope and context. Do not silently treat command failure as successful empty work.

facts.subject: CommandResult
facts.statement: Script-issued critical commands should validate CommandResult success counts or caught errors against expected cardinality; mere absence of an exception is not sufficient when target count matters.

facts.subject: script-issued command dimension
facts.statement: Script code must choose Dimension.runCommand from the intended gameplay dimension or deliberately use entity-bound execution; defaulting to an arbitrary/common dimension is unsafe for cross-dimension maps.

facts.subject: relative coordinates
facts.statement: Commands using ~ or local/relative spatial assumptions require a proven current execution position/rotation/anchor. Analyzer should flag relative coordinates whose context was not established in the same command path.

facts.subject: selector cardinality
facts.statement: Each critical selector should declare expected cardinality: exactly-one, at-least-one, zero-or-one, or many. Commands such as teleport destination selection must fail closed when actual cardinality violates the contract.

facts.subject: function command context
facts.statement: Treat mcfunction execution as inheriting the caller's command context unless the function explicitly changes it; analyzer must track the call-site envelope across function boundaries.
